title: Weights in étale cohomology over mixed-characteristic local fields and applications to anabelian geometry
summary: In anabelian geometry, Kummer-faithful fields are expected to be suitable as base fields. In recent years, to characterize Kummer-faithfulness in terms of Galois representations, Ozeki and Taguchi defined a notion of (quasi-)highly Kummer-faithful fields as a variant, and posed the following natural question: Are sub-$p$-adic fields quasi-highly Kummer-faithful? In this paper, by studying the weights of $\ell$-adic étale cohomology over mixed-characteristic local fields and discussing the $p$-adic analogue, we give an affirmative answer to this question.
